name: Antelope Valley Spring Open 2013
information: The cost of registration is $6 for the first event, plus $2 for each event past the first. If not pre-registered by Saturday, March 30th, the cost of registration is increased to $6 for the first event, plus $4 for each event past the first. $1 per competitor goes to the WCA. Spectators are free. See website for more details.
